description: Permanent three-role separation, identical logical model in every environment. Role NAMES, passwords, connection URLs, hosts and secret paths are NEVER hard-coded here; they are environment-provisioned and injected only through the read-only file secret interface.

stable_schema_owner.purpose: Stable ownership context for all migration-created objects. Objects created by migrations remain owned by this role, not by any short-lived login.

runtime_application_role.privileges: minimum required by approved services (DML + USAGE on owned schema)

migration_role.ownership_compatibility: acts through the stable_schema_owner (member of / SET ROLE) so migration-created objects are owned by stable_schema_owner; NEVER receives permanent ownership of objects

ownership_compatible_migration.mechanism: The migration login is granted membership in the stable_schema_owner role and runs with SET ROLE to that owner (or an equivalent owner-scoped run), so canonical SQLx structural migrations (CREATE/ALTER/DROP of owned objects) succeed while newly created objects remain owned by the stable_schema_owner.
ownership_compatible_migration.note: Plain DML grants are NOT sufficient for structural migrations. The migration role requires owner-equivalent structural capability via the stable owner, scoped to the environment, without SUPERUSER, CREATEROLE, CREATEDB, REPLICATION or BYPASSRLS.
forbidden: permanent object ownership by the short-lived migration login
